_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Saturday — W16 amplification day. (1) Figma stock falls ~7% on the Friday Claude Design launch as design community mass-tests across Figma Make / Canva Magic Design / Adobe Express; Get AI Perks + BuildFast With AI position Claude Design as 'the AI tool that wants to replace Figma'; Pro/Max bundling turns every existing Claude subscriber (50M+) into a free Figma alternative vs Figma's ~13M paid seats — cleanest AI-disintermediation trade of Q2 (cleaner than the Salesforce Saaspocalypse selloff); Anima ships first explicit Claude-Design-to-Figma round-trip guide. (2) ServiceNow + Anthropic Build Agent gets weekend analyst amplification — 'single most consequential enterprise-stack standardisation in the Anthropic playbook to date — even bigger than the M365 Claude integration' because Build Agent sits in the developer surface of every ServiceNow customer (8,500 base). (3) xAI Grok 4.3 Beta Saturday review wave — 16-agent Heavy system retained, 2M context, native video + audio APIs, batch image/video, XChat, standalone STT/TTS — but absence of persistent memory at $300/mo flagged; price-segmentation contrast with OpenAI/Anthropic flat tiering now in discourse. (4) Anthropic's Project Glasswing page quietly adds consortium roster updates (cybersecurity/financial-services slots). Research (Sat backfill, Friday cohort, deduped vs 04-17): Dive into Claude Code architectural anatomy with OpenClaw comparison, Corpus2Skill (Don't-Retrieve-Navigate), UniDoc-RL 17.7% gains, MMA2A modality-native A2A routing (52% vs 32% task completion for vision-dependent tasks), DR^3-Eval deep-research realism, KV Packet trainable soft-token adapters, SafeDream proactive jailbreak detection. Blogs: Willison Claude system-prompts diff Opus 4.6→4.7 + git-timeline repo + Agentic Engineering Patterns chapter; Matt Mochalkin '6 Critical Challenges Facing MCP in 2026'. STAGE MOVES: none — Sat consolidates Friday's signals.
